vocabulary.example: We start every project with a kickoff meeting.
vocabulary.tts_text: We start every project with a kickoff meeting.

vocabulary.example: All key stakeholders are invited today.
vocabulary.example_cz: Dnes jsou pozvány všechny klíčové zainteresované strany.
vocabulary.tts_text: All key stakeholders are invited today.

vocabulary.example: Let's define the scope of the project first.
vocabulary.tts_text: Let's define the scope of the project first.

vocabulary.example: The main objective is to launch by June.
vocabulary.example_cz: Hlavním cílem je spustit projekt do června.
vocabulary.tts_text: The main objective is to launch by June.

vocabulary.example: Here is the timeline for the next three months.
vocabulary.example_cz: Tady je časový plán na následující tři měsíce.
vocabulary.tts_text: Here is the timeline for the next three months.

vocabulary.example: The first deliverable is due next week.
vocabulary.example_cz: První výstup má termín příští týden.
vocabulary.tts_text: The first deliverable is due next week.

vocabulary.example: Each team member has a clear role.
vocabulary.example_cz: Každý člen týmu má jasnou roli.
vocabulary.tts_text: Each team member has a clear role.

vocabulary.example: Do we have enough resources for this project?
vocabulary.example_cz: Máme na tento projekt dostatek zdrojů?
vocabulary.tts_text: Do we have enough resources for this project?

vocabulary.example: The project sponsor approved the budget.
vocabulary.tts_text: The project sponsor approved the budget.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Welcome everyone, let's start the kickoff meeting.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thanks for inviting me. What's the main objective of the project?
lines.text_cz: Díky za pozvání. Jaký je hlavní cíl projektu?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The objective is to launch the new app by the end of the quarter.
lines.text_cz: Cílem je spustit novou aplikaci do konce čtvrtletí.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Great, and who are the key stakeholders?
lines.text_cz: Skvělé, a kdo jsou klíčové zainteresované strany?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The marketing and IT departments, plus our project sponsor.
lines.text_cz: Marketingové a IT oddělení a náš sponzor projektu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Let's define the scope before we go further.
lines.text_cz: Než budeme pokračovat, definujme rozsah projektu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure. What is the first deliverable?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A working prototype, according to the timeline.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do we have enough resources for that?
